reviewer: AI editorial review using opened primary and public-sector sources

feature.basis: IEA supports the global electricity estimates, scenario uncertainty, efficiency context, and geographic concentration. Berkeley Lab supports the 2023 US direct-water estimate and distinction between consumption and withdrawal. Virginia JLARC supports the bounded 2024 findings about construction-led benefits, ongoing employment, power costs, water variability, siting, and noise. The article labels forecasts and local evidence and does not generalize the Virginia findings to every facility.
